item.subject: science
item.stem:
For a school project, Meena's class in Pune discusses why the Earth can support living things while the Moon cannot. Meena says that the rocks, soil and minerals of the Earth's crust are just a lifeless background and do not really help living things.

Which statement best explains why Meena is wrong?

options.A: Rocks and minerals are non-living, so they cannot help living things survive.
options.B: Soil formed from broken-down rocks and the remains of plants and animals contains nutrients such as nitrogen and potassium, which plants need to grow.
options.C: The Earth's crust is useful to life only because it provides metals for making tools and buildings.
options.D: Geodiversity matters only because it makes the landscape look varied and beautiful.
